_doc: The wounded stay when the camera leaves them (Pwalkers-14): at the street corner at (60, 8) a level round at the legs of the walker nearest knocks them down and a second at their legs takes a leg off ({legRound}: LookArgs), down for good and bleeding; the camera on them (setViewNear body, 110 px a metre, from 210 degrees at 35), then 840 m east, past where the walking window takes walkers away (600 m x 1.2), for 240 frames with the clock running, then back: they lie where they fell, bleeding, their body and its pool there; from 90 degrees and from above; then, 1500 frames on, bled out where they lay, the body kept (aimed at where the first run found the body, (63.6, 19.0): the dead are no walker for setViewNear to find).
